name: m5-kwu-t8-bimodal-jit

variantDescriptions.kwu: 8 independent compiles at once, chunked-weak + uncache-all, G1 defaults, 24 GB

description: Forks of the same setting at 8 compiles fall into two groups, ~11.7 s or ~13.3-14.9 s per compile (m5-kwu-t8-pausegoal, job 585; also m5-kwu-t8-tenuring), not explained by load or thermal state. Six forks of one setting with the JIT recorded over each whole fork (`jit-<pid>.jitrec`), so `perflab api jit` and `jit_diff` can compare a fast fork with a slow one.
